manual_derivations.result: Private first-order midpoint prediction with actual geometry and Euler GCL; no accepted exchange.
One captured nu per macro attempt; physical stages recomputed from the accepted state using that linear path.
Conditional frozen-velocity flow expansion includes G_nu times the state-dependent midpoint velocity derivative; local O(H^3) under declared smoothness and solve assumptions.
Inner refinements share one path and never rebuild nu; an outer retry recomputes the midpoint and path from the immutable accepted state.
Off-path midpoint predictor cannot witness a physical event. Linear physical stages remove that specific mismatch but do not certify coverage or solve S20 short-face aliasing.
